proof_details: The free denominators retain a half-unit gap on a ball about every closed-strip point. Uniform local infinity bounds and the existing bounded-coordinate analytic theorem give Banach, not just scalar coordinate, analyticity.

The regular Wiener resolvent is assembled from its proved l1 reciprocal symbol; signed Sobolev convolution is a bounded bilinear map. The total tail family is jointly analytic and equals the existing Fourier/physical operator.

The total ring inverse equals the actual tail inverse wherever the already proved cutoff applies. The effective two-mode determinant remains analytic at its zeros; the singular effective matrix itself is not inverted.

The canonical inverse on the original endpoint carrier has norm at most two in BOTH opposite shifted norms, for every source spectral weight. Opposite modulation of each resonant source column exactly cancels its norm shift.
Each effective column has norm <=2*<2n>^r*norm(q). Since C_r>=24, the original half-contraction criterion implies that this is <=sqrt(n)/8. No extra norm-smallness or cutoff premise is imposed.

The shared two-dimensional determinant estimate and existing Rouche zero-count theorem prove exactly two zeros by analytic order in the source disc of radius4*sqrt(n). Localization puts every strip zero within sqrt(n)/4, so the same two zeros exhaust the whole unbounded corrected strip.
qualifications: The full root-separation estimate(23) is now proved; see spectral-coefficients-map.json and sourceLemma2_11_uniform. Physical spectral labels and algebraic-multiplicity correspondence remain open.

The analytic statement is in the exact endpoint NORM topology. It does not claim Banach analyticity in the weak-star topology or identify a real Banach manifold structure on the constrained source subtype.

proof_details: The order-two infinity symbol multiplied by the inverse Sobolev order1-r weight in l2 gives a total operator-norm analytic complementary inverse from endpoint data into the original full H1 space. It equals the existing physical inverse and agrees with the analytic Wiener realization.

The original physical pencil lambda*J-L(q) is jointly operator-norm analytic. The actual reconstruction from two amplitudes into original H1 is jointly analytic at every closed-strip parameter allowed by the existing cutoff, including effective determinant zeros.

Reconstruction has the exact constant resonant-coordinate left inverse and the exact physical residual J*Modes*B. The complementary response is analytic, has zero resonant coordinates and its physical residual is the original forcing minus the solved finite resonant defect.

Every original H1 solution with arbitrary endpoint right-hand side has the exact reconstruction f=F(lambda)*C*f+G(lambda)*g. Its two coordinates satisfy B(lambda)*C*f=C_endpoint*K(lambda)*g. Conversely these two conditions imply the full original physical equation, including at singular effective matrices.

Actual determinant zeros lie strictly inside the corrected6n strip by the proved sqrt(n)/4 localization. The physical residual and constant-coordinate identities hold as spectral germs near every such zero, rather than only pointwise.

The source wrappers parameterize by the entire original complex endpoint Banach space with its exact norm, retain arbitrary original endpoint forcing and full original H1 solutions, and preserve the original physical H-minus-one distribution normalization.
